item.title: The Devil's Daughter: A 12-Year-Old Does the Unthinkable!
item.description: t just 12 years old, Sharon Carr lashed out with inexplicable violence, leading to the tragic death of Katie Rackliff. As we navigate through Sharon's early life, searching for factors that may have contributed to this violent outburst, I can't help but ask: Was it her tumultuous upbringing, a deep-seated psychological disorder, or something more sinister that led Sharon down this dark path?

item.title: The Dating App Match That Ended in an Alleged Murder-for-Hire Plot
item.description: Aimee Betro flew from the US to Birmingham and allegedly became part of a revenge plot against a rival family. Disguised in a niqab, she pulled a gun at point-blank range—but it jammed. What followed was a bizarre case involving a dating app, CCTV footage, threatening texts, and years on the run.
